title: Structural T-Cell Receptor Analysis in the Age of Machine Learning.
authors: Quast, Nele P; Raybould, Matthew I J; Deane, Charlotte M
one_liner_zh: 该文综述了机器学习时代T细胞受体结构预测、特异性推断及计算设计的方法与挑战，虽聚焦TCR蛋白结构，但以综述为主，方法创新性有限。
abstract: The development of highly accurate deep learning models for protein structure prediction has transformed the landscape of T-cell receptor (TCR) structure data, which can now be accessed at repertoire scale. We provide a perspective on the growing field of structural TCR immunoinformatics, summarizing core principles of TCR structural biology and highlighting existing resources and tools. We outline computational methods for TCR structure prediction, and discuss outstanding challenges faced by current tools, as well as potential avenues to address these. We expand on the research enabled by the availability of predicted TCR structures, exploring the utility of TCR structure predictions for computationally inferring TCR specificity, as well as summarizing opportunities emerging from the adjacent field of antibody research. Finally, we provide a forward-looking perspective on the advances in deep learning research which have recently enabled computational design of TCRs and TCR-like binders.
abstract_zh: 用于蛋白质结构预测的高精度深度学习模型的发展，已经改变了T细胞受体（TCR）结构数据的格局，这些数据现在可以在库规模上获取。我们对结构TCR免疫信息学这一日益发展的领域提供了展望，总结了TCR结构生物学的核心原理，并强调了现有的资源和工具。我们概述了用于TCR结构预测的计算方法，并讨论了当前工具面临的突出挑战，以及解决这些挑战的潜在途径。我们进一步阐述了由预测TCR结构可用性所推动的研究，探索了TCR结构预测在计算推断TCR特异性方面的实用性，并总结了来自相邻抗体研究领域的新机遇。最后，我们对深度学习研究的进展提供了前瞻性视角，这些进展最近已使TCR及TCR样结合物的计算设计成为可能。
